_comment: Golden set for the retrieval/routing layer. These assert on PIPELINE behaviour that is deterministic and checkable offline (did we detect the game? will we scrape? does the answer trip a hallucination guard?), NOT on LLM prose, which is not reproducible. Live answer quality is measured separately by tests/eval/live.mjs against a deployed endpoint.
